layers.message: Document CSV export in usage guide
Route export guide rework to documentation
Add worked CSV example to export guide

graderOnly: The correction named by recovery frame 1 (a worked CSV example with quoted titles in the usage guide's export section) is saved in docs/usage.md and matches the CSV that test/integration/export-flow.test.ts expects; it is verified.

DOC-002 (download instructions for the admin tool's Exports page) cannot be written accurately with any evidence in this repository: the page is unfinished, owned outside the workflow, and the service has no route for fetching saved exports. The record states that the user will not sign off without it, so it is required documentation work that blocks the full Documenter gate.

The recovery frame's ResumeAt is AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, a user-owned state, so Documenter Corrective Return does not apply; popping the frame to sign-off would also skip the final-deliverable review and synchronization, both of which assessed the guide before the rework edit.
There are no implementation, test, or other independent defects; the implementation and tests are unchanged since verification.

all.why: the full Documenter gate cannot pass while DOC-002 is open
no return to AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF and no forward move into REVIEWING_FINAL or SYNCHRONIZING
the frame must not be popped
the remaining owner dependency stays recorded

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check finds no new problem
Documenter does not edit other roles' records

selfChecks.why: integration suite passes, including the owner=dana export the guide's example reproduces
the recovery state at DOCUMENTING is valid

notes: Builds on export-documenting. 50-guide: Documenter's first pass adds the 'Exporting records as CSV' section and an admin-only line to docs/usage.md and updates README intro/layout. 51-doc-record: documentation record COMPLETE (no discrepancies), STATE REVIEWING_FINAL. 52-final-review: FINAL_DELIVERABLE review COMPLETE, no findings, STATE SYNCHRONIZING. 54-sync: synchronization record COMPLETE, STATE AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF. 56-rework: user rework at sign-off recorded: Handoff USER_REWORK from AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, FailureType DOCUMENTATION, one frame From AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, Owner DOCUMENTING, ResumeAt AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, RerunThrough NONE; Reason names the correction (worked CSV example with quoted titles). 57-example: the correction saved in docs/usage.md (matches integration test output). 58-progress: documentation record reopened IN_PROGRESS: DOC-001 (the named correction) RESOLVED with checks C2/C3; DOC-002 OPEN: the user also asked for download instructions for the admin tool's Exports page, which the admin-tool team has not finished (owner outside the workflow, through the user; alternatively a scope change for Scoper); the record says the user will not sign off without it. The case's 'unfinished owner work' is this unfinished page; the case left the owner unspecified, so assertion 0's state checks allow staying in DOCUMENTING (blocking) or routing a failure to an earlier owner, and forbid popping the frame, entering REVIEWING_FINAL/SYNCHRONIZING/AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF, or marking the record COMPLETE.
